_readme: Party synergies are matched against the TAGS on characters and their traits, not against specific character ids - so they keep working when you rewrite the whole cast. 'requires_tags' needs at least 'count' distinct crew members carrying that tag. Bonuses apply to checks whose choice carries one of 'contexts' (empty = all checks).

synergies.name: Brains Trust
synergies.description: Two technical minds. +12% on technical and planning work.
synergies.flavor: They argue constantly and are right constantly.

synergies.name: The Heavy Lifting
synergies.description: Two heavy hitters. +12% on physical work.
synergies.flavor: Between them they can move anything except each other.

synergies.name: Smooth Operators
synergies.flavor: One distracts, one closes. Neither has ever admitted which is which.

synergies.name: Shadow Crew
synergies.flavor: Nobody can confirm they were ever in the room.

synergies.name: Blessed Mess
synergies.description: Two absurdly lucky people. +8% on everything.

synergies.name: Chaos Engine
synergies.description: Two agents of chaos. Criticals of both kinds become far more likely.
synergies.flavor: Nothing this crew does will ever be described as 'fine'.

synergies.name: Field Hospital
synergies.description: Somebody here knows medicine. +15% on medical work.

synergies.name: Quick Feet
synergies.description: Two fast movers. +12% on anything timed.
synergies.flavor: They race each other to things. It is exhausting for everybody.

synergies.name: A Balanced Crew
synergies.flavor: Somebody actually planned this. Nobody will admit to it.

synergies.name: All In One Lane
synergies.description: Four heavies. Outstanding at force, dismal at everything else.
synergies.flavor: The plan has one step and it is 'push'.
